import React, { useState, useEffect } from 'react' import { useParams, useNavigate } from 'react-router-dom' import axios from 'axios' export const PurchaseOrderDetailScreen = () => { const { id } = useParams<{ id: string }>() const navigate = useNavigate() const [poDetails, setPoDetails] = useState(null) const [items, setItems] = useState([]) const [loading, setLoading] = useState(false) const [error, setError] = useState(null) const API_BASE_URL = import.meta.env.VITE_API_URL || 'https://celerant-backend.agreeablemeadow-3f37c30d.westus2.azurecontainerapps.io' useEffect(() => { loadPODetails() }, [id]) const loadPODetails = async () => { if (!id) return setLoading(true) setError(null) try { const response = await axios.get(`${API_BASE_URL}/api/purchase-orders/${id}`) setPoDetails(response.data) // Also load the items for this PO const itemsResponse = await axios.get(`${API_BASE_URL}/api/purchase-orders/${id}/items`) setItems(itemsResponse.data || []) } catch (err: any) { setError( err.response?.data?.detail || err.message || 'Failed to load purchase order details' ) } finally { setLoading(false) } } const handleBackToList = () => { navigate('/purchase-orders') } const handleReceiveItems = () => { navigate(`/receiving?poNumber=${poDetails?.po_number}`) } if (loading || !id) { return (

Currency: {poDetails.currency}

{item.item_id} {item.description} {item.quantity} ${parseFloat(item.unit_cost || 0).toFixed(2)} ${lineTotal.toFixed(2)} {received} {remaining.toFixed(0)}
